What CTET Paper 2 asks on Fractions and Decimals

Questions cover types of fractions, equivalent fractions, comparing and ordering, the four operations on fractions and decimals, and conversion between fractions, decimals and percentages.

Key facts & formulas to remember

  • Proper fraction: numerator < denominator; improper: numerator ≥ denominator; mixed: whole + fraction.
  • To add or subtract, make denominators equal using the LCM.
  • To divide by a fraction, multiply by its reciprocal.
  • 1/2 = 0.5 = 50%, 1/4 = 0.25 = 25%, 3/4 = 0.75 = 75%.
  • Decimal place value after the point: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Adding numerators and denominators directly (1/2 + 1/3 ≠ 2/5).
  • Forgetting to simplify the final fraction.
  • Misplacing the decimal point when multiplying or dividing decimals.

quiz.about: CTET Paper 2 Maths: Fractions and Decimals

questions.q: Which of the following is a proper fraction?
questions.explanation: A proper fraction has a numerator less than its denominator. Here, 3 < 8, so 3/8 is proper.

questions.q: Which of the following is an improper fraction?
questions.explanation: An improper fraction has a numerator greater than or equal to its denominator. Here, 5 > 2, so 5/2 is improper.

questions.q: Express the improper fraction 43/7 as a mixed fraction.
questions.explanation: Divide 43 by 7: quotient is 6 and remainder is 1. Thus, 43/7 = 6(1/7).
Convert to improper fractions: 13/4 - 11/6 + 7/3. Common denominator = 12. = (39 - 22 + 28) / 12 = 45 / 12 = 15 / 4 = 3(3/4).

questions.q: Which of the following fractions is NOT equivalent to 12/18?
questions.explanation: 12/18 simplified to lowest terms is 2/3. (A) 2/3 = 2/3; (B) 8/12 = 2/3; (C) 20/30 = 2/3; (D) 15/20 simplifies to 3/4, which is not equivalent to 2/3.

questions.q: Which of the following fractions is equivalent to 4/7?
questions.explanation: Multiplying both the numerator and denominator of 4/7 by 4 gives 4 x 4/7 x 4 = 16/28.
Multiplying numerator and denominator of 3/4 by 2 gives 6/8, which is equivalent.

questions.q: Which fraction is NOT equivalent to 3/4?
questions.explanation: 3/4 = 6/8 = 9/12 = 12/16. However, 5/8 cannot be simplified or expanded to equal 3/4.

questions.q: Find the missing numerator in the equivalent fraction statement: 5 / 8 = x / 72.
questions.explanation: The denominator increased by a factor of 72 ÷ 8 = 9. Multiply the numerator by the same factor: 5 × 9 = 45.

faq.q: How do you compare two fractions quickly?
faq.a: Cross-multiply, or convert both to the same denominator (or to decimals) and compare.

faq.q: How do you convert a fraction to a percentage?
faq.a: Divide the numerator by the denominator to get a decimal, then multiply by 100. For example, 3/4 = 0.75 = 75%.
